_readme: App Store Connect listing for Muster. Fields marked in _synced are rewritten from app.config.json by `npm run release:config`, which also regenerates store/LISTING.md and store/IAP.md and checks every length limit. In the copy, {{name}} is the store name and {{units}}, {{abilities}}, {{levels}}, {{acts}}, {{actsWord}}, {{bosses}}, {{puzzles}} are counted from base/src/core (tools/content-counts.ts), so they never go stale. Edit the copy here, then run that command.
name: Remuster
subtitle: Auto battler army strategy
subtitleAlternatives: Place your army. Watch it win
promotionalText: New: a Daily Challenge for everyone, three new acts and seven new units. Free to play with every level open. No ads, no tracking, offline.
description:
Muster an army. Place it. Watch it fight.

{{name}} is a turn-based army battler for one player. Each round you buy units from a shop of four and place them anywhere on your half of the field. Then you press Fight and the battle plays out on its own. Your units stay on the board and come back every round, so your army grows as the match goes on. Lose a round and your commander takes damage. First commander to zero loses.

{{units}} UNITS, EACH WITH A MIND OF ITS OWN
No grid and no lanes: every unit steers freely and fights its own way. Blade Trios surround a target and slash as a pack. Rangers hold their distance and back off when rushed. Lancers charge straight through a line, wheel round and charge again. Shades cloak, blink behind the weakest enemy and strike. Mines lie buried until someone steps too close. Harriers fly over the melee, Sappers tunnel to the backline, Stormcallers chain lightning through tight formations. Where you place them decides the fight.

EVOLVE THEM. ASCEND THEM.
Rank a unit up from Recruit to Veteran to Elite and it looks tougher and hits harder at every step. From round 5 you can Ascend it: a transformed unit with a signature ability. Whirlwind slashes, Volley arrows, a Revive, Firebombs, Trample charges, Deep Freeze, Shrapnel shells and more. One Ascended ability for every unit, {{abilities}} in all.

RIVALS THAT THINK
Rivals plan their own draft and formation, and the toughest ones test their plans against your board before they commit. Buried mines stay hidden from them, so a good trap still springs. In the AI Lab you can tune a rival yourself: difficulty, aggression, tactic (swarm, fortress, artillery, ambush, blitz or siege), economy, rerolls and formation width. Or set two AIs against each other and watch.

FIVE WAYS TO PLAY
• Campaign: {{levels}} levels across {{actsWord}} acts, each act ending in a boss fight. Unlock new units as you go and earn up to three stars on every level.
• Daily Challenge: one board a day, the same for every player. Win it, keep your streak going and beat your best.
• Gauntlet: one health pool against rival after rival. Your army carries over and every win brings a boon.
• Breakpoint: {{puzzles}} one-battle puzzles against a fixed board with fixed gold. Find the win, then find a cheaper one for the stars.
• Skirmish: any rival, any settings, any starting health.

FREE TO PLAY, EVERY LEVEL OPEN
Every act of the campaign, the Gauntlet, every Breakpoint puzzle, the Daily Challenge and Skirmish are free, for as long as you like. Nothing is locked behind a purchase.
Optional purchases only speed you up. A one-time Starter Pack gives gems, coins and unit cards to get your army going. Gems are earned free from three-star clears, bosses, Daily wins and streaks, and spent on coins for troop upgrades or a Gauntlet Rally; gem packs in the Shop speed that up. Each season's War Pass fills as you play, with free rewards for everyone and an optional Premium track; limited-time special offers rotate in the Shop. Every purchase says exactly what you get, and every chest shows its odds before you open or buy it: no subscriptions, no energy.

PLAYS YOUR WAY
• Short rounds that fit a spare minute, with 2× and 3× battle speed
• Fully offline: no account, no sign-in, no internet needed to play
• No ads, no tracking, no energy
• Your progress stays on your device
whatsNew:
Daily Challenge: a new board every day, the same for every player, with a streak to keep. Free for everyone.
Three new acts: Act 8, the Saltwind Coast in Act 9 and the Crownfall Citadel finale in Act 10, with eighteen new levels, three new bosses and an ending.
Seven new units, each with its own Ascended ability, among them three legendaries: the Griffin Knight, the Tidecaller and the Lionheart.
Free to play: every act, the Gauntlet and every Breakpoint puzzle are open to everyone. Optional purchases (a one-time Starter Pack and gem packs) only speed you up.
Gems: earn them free from three-star clears, bosses, Daily wins and streaks, or buy a pack in the Shop. Spend them on coins for troop upgrades or a Gauntlet Rally.
Sunlit new art across units, arenas and menus.
War Pass: a 30-day season of rewards filled by three daily quests and your wins, free for everyone, with an optional Premium track. Special offers rotate in the Shop.

appPrivacy.label: Data Not Collected
appPrivacy.answer: App Privacy > Get Started > 'Do you or your third-party partners collect data from this app?' = No, we do not collect data from this app. Then Publish. Still true with the in-app purchases: Apple takes the payment outside the app, and what was bought is credited and remembered on the device only. Apple's rule: data processed only on device is not 'collected' (https://developer.apple.com/support/app-privacy-on-the-app-store/).
appPrivacy.tracking: No tracking. No third-party SDKs (StoreKit is Apple's own). No analytics, ads or crash reporting.

exportCompliance: Handled in the binary: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = NO in Info.plist, so App Store Connect does not ask.
reviewNotes:
{{name}} is a single-player strategy game. No account or sign-in, no ads, no tracking. The game itself never uses the network; the only network use is Apple's own purchase sheet (StoreKit 2).

Free to play: every campaign act, the Gauntlet, the Daily Challenge, Skirmish (AI Lab) and every Breakpoint puzzle. Nothing is locked behind a purchase; purchases only speed progress up.
In-app purchases, all consumables: a one-time Starter Pack (co.inflect.muster.starter), sold once per player and hidden after it's bought, with 1,200 gems, 6,000 coins and 142 unit cards; and five gem packs (co.inflect.muster.gems.pouch, .sack, .coffer, .trove, .hoard). Gems are a premium currency spent on coin bundles (troop upgrades) and a once-per-run Gauntlet Rally. Also War Pass Premium (co.inflect.muster.pass), a consumable sold once per 30-day season that adds the season's premium reward track (title screen > War Pass), and four special-offer price tiers (co.inflect.muster.offer.t1-t4) for limited-time bundles whose fixed gems, coins and cards are shown in the Shop with one chest. Every purchase states its contents; the only random part is a chest's contents, and every chest's odds are shown (Odds button) before it is bought or opened. Gems are also earned free by playing. There are no non-consumables, so there is no Restore Purchases button.

To test with a sandbox account: on the title screen tap Shop, then tap the Starter Pack price button (or a gem pack's, or a special offer's) and confirm; War Pass Premium is on the War Pass screen. The price shown comes from the App Store.

How to play: tap Campaign, then level 1. Drag a unit card from the shop at the bottom onto your (lower) half of the board and tap FIGHT; the battle plays itself, and winning rounds brings the rival's health to zero.
Daily Challenge and Skirmish are open from the title screen for everyone.

gemPacks.reviewNotes: Gems are a consumable premium currency. Each pack gives the fixed number of gems in its name, credited the moment the purchase completes. Gems buy coin bundles (coins buy troop upgrades) and a once-per-run Gauntlet Rally; nothing gives random rewards. Gems are also earned free from three-star clears, bosses, Daily Challenge wins and streaks. No content is locked behind them: every level is free. To find them: title screen > Shop, the Gems section below the Starter Pack.

warPass.reviewNotes: War Pass Premium is a consumable the app sells once per 30-day season (the app refuses a second purchase in the same season). It adds a second reward track to the season's War Pass: gems, coins, chests, unit cards and a cosmetic keep skin, plus chests unlocking 20% faster. It is retroactive: rewards for tiers already reached become claimable at once. Every player progresses the pass for free through daily quests and wins, and the free track pays every player. Chest rewards show their odds (tap a chest). Nothing in battle changes and no content is locked: every level is free. It is credited once per transaction and only then finished. To find it: title screen > War Pass (or Pass tab), the Premium card below the daily quests.

specialOffers._note: Special offers: four generic consumable price tiers. Which bundle a tier pays is decided by the app (engine/store/offers.ts) and shown in the game before purchase; the App Store description stays generic. Generated into store/IAP.md by `npm run release:config`.
specialOffers.availability: All countries and regions (same as the app)
specialOffers.familySharing: Not offered for consumables (the switch isn't shown).
specialOffers.reviewNotes: Special offers are limited-time bundles shown in the Shop: 2 or 3 at a time, rotating every 2 days, each buyable once while it is up. Each bundle's exact contents are shown before purchase: a fixed number of gems and coins, a fixed number of cards for a named unit, and one chest. The chest's contents are random; its odds are shown by the Odds button on the offer card. These four products are price tiers the bundles sell through, so their App Store description is generic. Every bundle is credited once per transaction and only then finished. No content is locked: every level is free. To find them: title screen > Shop, Special offers below the Starter Pack.
